measurement.cold_load: fresh CPython process and fresh engine/model load for every successful fixture; OS filesystem caches were not purged
measurement.peak_memory: per-process 10 ms RSS sampling with pinned psutil
measurement.semantic_integrity: unverified unless ASR or blinded human scores are supplied
measurement.mps_determinism: seeded, but exact reproducibility is not guaranteed by the MPS backend

es-US.accent_evidence: es-MX comparator only; no exact es-US voice

piper.network_policy: Models must be explicitly fetched from the pinned revision and checksum-verified before synthesis.

multilingual-v3.benchmark_status: general comparator selected for the executable harness
multilingual-v3.voice_provenance: Zero-shot voice cloning; a user-supplied reference clip is required and must have recorded consent and usage rights.

es-mx-latam.benchmark_status: provenance-only regional candidate; no released pinned loader contract beyond the companion-asset note
es-mx-latam.voice_provenance: Latin-American Spanish regional checkpoint; not evidence of an es-US accent. PerTh watermarking remains enabled by the runtime.

pt-br.benchmark_status: provenance-only regional candidate; no released pinned loader contract beyond the companion-asset note
pt-br.voice_provenance: Brazilian Portuguese regional checkpoint; reference-voice consent is still required and PerTh watermarking remains enabled.

es-US.accent_evidence: generic es language ID only; the cataloged es-MX pack is provenance-only and is not exact es-US evidence

pt-BR.accent_evidence: generic pt language ID; the cataloged regional pack remains provenance-only until its loader contract is independently verified

chatterbox.network_policy: Runner accepts only a pre-fetched local snapshot and calls from_local; it never follows upstream's floating main revision.

model.checksum_status: not published for the managed neural service

polly.network_policy: Disabled unless --allow-network is supplied; credentials, cost, and service terms remain operator responsibilities.

decision.reason: Objective results alone cannot pass the required blinded human, locale-accent, semantic-integrity, and license gates.
decision.es-US: No open-source candidate has exact es-US accent evidence. Piper es-MX and Chatterbox es-MX/LatAm are comparators only; selection is forbidden until blinded es-US reviewer scores and license approval are recorded.
decision.next_step: Score successful blinded clips with qualified reviewers, add ASR or transcript review, and obtain license approval before choosing a replacement.
